title: Rape
sourceLines: -The law of Moses imposed death penalty for De 22:25-27
.Of the servant of a Levite, by Benjamites; the tribe of Benjamin nearly extermin- ated by the army of the other tribes, punishment for Jud 19:22-30; 20:35
.Of Tamar by Amnon; avenged in the death of Amnon at the hand of Absalom, Tamar’ s brother 2Sa 13:6-29,32,33
